symptom: pytest collects 135 items and reports three ModuleNotFoundError tests errors
root_cause: tests has no package marker; pytest console entrypoint adds tests directory rather than repository root to sys.path
fix: Add tests/__init__.py so pytest imports tests as a package
risk: Low: test package discovery only; no runtime change
evidence: User supplied CI traceback; local pytest 9.2.0 reproduced identical imports on Windows Python 3.12.10
